description: This file defines command classes for managing system themes in the Superset project, including setting and clearing default and dark themes.

classes.name: SetSystemDefaultThemeCommand
classes.description: Command to set a specific theme as the system default.

classes.name: SetSystemDarkThemeCommand
classes.description: Command to set a specific theme as the system dark theme.

classes.name: ClearSystemDefaultThemeCommand
classes.description: Command to clear the system default theme setting.

classes.name: ClearSystemDarkThemeCommand
classes.description: Command to clear the system dark theme setting.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the command to set or clear themes, handling database updates and logging.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the theme ID exists before performing operations.
